name: Transbank
description: Integrate Transbank (Webpay) payment services via the official SDK.
project_description:
This module integrates Transbank services using the official SDK.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module require some php extensions

 
 curl 
 json 
 mbstring 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Transbank PHP SDK (Included in composer.json): https://github.com/TransbankDevelopers/transbank-sdk-php 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Its recommend to download this module with composer https://getcomposer.org/ . See https://www.drupal.org/docs/extending-drupal/installing-modules#s-add-a… for further information.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Create a Services 
 Installing the module enables the administration path Configuration > Web Services > Transbank . In this section you can create multiple services with their respective credentials. Each service specifies a type, which will appear as the sub modules are installed, for example Webpay Plus.

 Each submodule will install a Services with certification credentials for testing.

 Commerce (For now only for Webpay plus) 
 Configure the payment method in commerce as usual, select Webpay Plus and specify the Service to use.

 Back to top 

 Services Integration Status 
 
 ✔️Webpay Plus : Implemented and full integration with Commerce Core (Includes the ability to make refunds). 
 ⚠️Webpay Plus Mall : not so implemented 
 ❌Webpay Modal : not implemented 
 ⚠️Oneclick : Implemented but classified as experimental 
 ❌Patpass : not implemented 
 ⚠️Complete Transaction : not so implemented and classified as experimental 
 ❌Onepay : not implemented 
 
 Back to top 

 Similar modules 
 This module comes to replace the modules

 
 Webpay 
 Commerce Webpay 
 
 The above modules only integrate Webpay Plus. 

 Instead, this module seeks to integrate with all Transbank services.

 Back to top
